# Upstream samples

These files are reproduced from official public sources for regression tests.

- `CVE-2021-44228.json` is a CVE List V5 record from
  https://github.com/CVEProject/cvelistV5
  Use is subject to the CVE Program Terms of Use. CVE is a registered
  trademark of The MITRE Corporation.
- `kev_cve_2021_44228.json` is a one-record excerpt of the CISA KEV catalog,
  dedicated to the public domain under CC0 1.0.
- `delta.json` is a reduced official-shaped excerpt of cvelistV5 `cves/delta.json`.
  The full `deltaLog.json` was 29,863,282 bytes on 2026-10-21 and is not stored.

Do not present these fixtures as a live Silastron intelligence snapshot.
